observations: Photo 0: a gold-coloured slim game console held in a hand, top cover with the PlayStation logo in the centre.
Photo 0: thin two-tier body with rounded corners and a front disc slot with eject and power buttons: the shape of a PS4 Slim, not a PS4 Pro or original PS4.
Photo 0: a second gold console of the same shape behind it, and stacks of black consoles in a shop; 'HYMAN GADGETS HUB' watermark, a dealer photo.
Photo 0: shell looks clean with no visible scratches or cracks at this resolution.
Photo 0: no controller, cables, accessories or box shown; model number and storage label on the back not shown; console not shown powered on.

identity.kind: PS4 Slim game console, gold finish
read_from: photo 0 PlayStation logo on the top cover
photo 0 slim two-tier body shape and front slot

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a clean gold shell with no visible marks, though only the top and front are shown.
Photo 0 shows the PlayStation logo and the PS4 Slim body shape.
Gold finish is visible in photo 0, but it could be a wrap or respray; no box or label shown.
No cables or accessories shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Console does not power on, disc drive or HDMI port faulty, or overheats.
risks.proof: Clip powering it on to the home screen on a TV, then inserting and reading a disc.

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown; smaller drive is worth less.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear label showing the CUH model number and capacity, or the System Information screen.

risks.risk: Controller missing or faulty with stick drift.
risks.proof: Clip of the controller pairing and moving the cursor, with sticks at rest showing no drift.

risks.risk: Console banned from online play or account locked.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the console signed in to PlayStation Network.

risks.risk: Shop photo of stock, not the exact unit sold.
risks.proof: Fresh photo of the exact unit with a handwritten code and its serial label in shot.

proof_requests: Clip powering it on to the home screen with the controller working.
Photo of the rear label showing model number, capacity and serial.
Screenshot of System Information showing storage and firmware.
Photo of the controller, cables and accessories with a handwritten code in shot.
response.reason: The PlayStation logo and slim body identify a PS4 Slim in gold, so it is priced at its worst case: smallest storage, no controller and not proven working, until the clips and labels are shown.
